source_caption:
🎬 Never Have I Ever (2020–2023)

Never Have I Ever follows Devi Vishwakumar, a smart, ambitious, and outspoken Indian American teenager trying to navigate the complicated world of high school while coping with the sudden death of her father. Determined to reinvent herself and improve her social status, Devi begins a new school year with an ambitious plan to become popular, experience romance, and leave behind the embarrassing moments of her past. Alongside her best friends Eleanor and Fabiola, she encounters hilarious misunderstandings, complicated crushes, unexpected rivalries, and emotional challenges that constantly disrupt her plans. Her romantic life becomes especially complicated when she develops feelings for Paxton Hall-Yoshida, a popular athlete, while maintaining a competitive relationship with Ben Gross, her academically gifted rival. Meanwhile, Devi struggles with her strict but loving mother, Nalini, whose expectations often clash with her daughter’s desire for independence. As she navigates friendships, family traditions, school pressures, and personal insecurities, Devi gradually begins confronting the grief and emotional struggles she has tried to avoid. Through awkward encounters, heartfelt conversations, and unforgettable teenage adventures, she learns that growing up involves making mistakes, accepting responsibility, and appreciating the people who truly care about her. Combining sharp comedy, emotional storytelling, relatable characters, and meaningful cultural representation, Never Have I Ever explores friendship, romance, identity, family, grief, self-confidence, and the unpredictable journey of becoming an adult.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Drama • Romance • Coming-of-Age

⭐ IMDb: 7.8/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 25–35 minutes per episode • TV-14

🎥 Creators: Mindy Kaling & Lang Fisher

📺 Where to Watch: Netflix. Availability varies by region.

source_details.title: Never Have I Ever
source_details.synopsis: Never Have I Ever is an American comedy-drama television series created by Mindy Kaling and Lang Fisher. It premiered on Netflix on April 27, 2020 and stars Maitreyi Ramakrishnan, who plays an Indian-American high school student dealing with the sudden death of her father and the bumpy journey through her last three years of high school. Though it takes place in the San Fernando Valley, the series has been reported to be loosely based on Kaling's childhood experiences in the Boston area, while Kaling herself has said it is based "in the spirit of my childhood".
